We need to inspect network. Inputs x0,x1. Hidden weights matrix 4x2: rows: unit0: [0,1]; unit1: [0,-1]; unit2: [1,0]; unit3: [-1,0]. biases all zero. So hidden activations: h0 = ReLU(0*x0 +1*x1)=ReLU(x1). h1=ReLU(0*x0 -1*x1)=ReLU(-x1). h2=ReLU(1*x0 +0)=ReLU(x0). h3=ReLU(-1*x0 +0)=ReLU(-x0).

Output weights 2x4: row for class0: [0,0,-1,1]; class1: [0,0,1,-1]. biases zero.

So logits: z0 = -h2 + h3. z1 = h2 - h3.

Thus z1 = -(z0). So argmax: if z1>z0 => z1> -z1 => z1>0 => h2>h3. If z1<z0 => h2<h3. If equal => tie, class0 wins. So classification is class1 iff h2>h3. h2=ReLU(x0). h3=ReLU(-x0). For x0>0: h2=x0>0, h3=0 => h2>h3 => class1. For x0<0: h2=0, h3=-x0>0 => h2<h3 => class0. For x0=0: both 0 tie => class0. So correct. No nuisance override. So answer NONE.
